pullRequests.title: build(port): connect Going Commando to current RAC2 master
pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: codex/rac2-hostgen-master
pullRequests.body:
The Going Commando port still read the old candidates/ layout and LVL_...FUN_... names, so it translated none of the current RAC2 matching C. This PR syncs the embedded decompilation to RAC2 master at 86dbd852 and makes hostgen read src/, the level placement catalogue, and the RAC2 overlay relocation range.
The newer source has a file with a function-local signed extern followed by an unsigned file-scope declaration of the same symbol. Hostgen now keeps those declarations separate in its…
